releaseNotes: Team rosters, lineups, team stats and walk-up music. Add players (name + number) to a team in Team setup, set the batting order with up/down arrows, and flag your player with the My Player toggle so their at-bats feed player stats automatically. Start a game with a lineup editor plus an opponent lineup (number and name, either or both). In game, the current batter is shown, a Lineup button allows quick changes that persist across games, and batters with a music clip get a Play Music button that turns into Stop while playing (Stop fades out over 3 seconds). Walk-up music clips are picked from phone storage, up to 1 minute, and play at the phone's volume independently of the in-app sounds setting.
